fact: Underline is one property of the whole text element. It is set by an "Underline" toggle (tooltip "Underline") and by Ctrl+U / Cmd+U, which toggles it on a selected text or while editing, also when only part of the text is selected, without opening the browser's page source. With nothing selected, Ctrl+U does nothing in the app.

fact: The "Underline" toggle is shown when a text, a shape with text or an arrow with a label is selected, or the Text tool is active, and is hidden for shapes without text and when nothing is selected; with several texts of different underline values it shows a mixed state, and one click sets underline on all of them.

fact: Underline is drawn per line, as wide as that line's text and following text align, with none under empty lines. It has the text's stroke color and opacity. Its thickness and distance below the baseline scale with font size, it may cross descenders, and it is never clipped.

fact: The last chosen underline value becomes the default for new text.
